reason: 该插件的核心用途是为 DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows 环境提供可切换的 Bash 执行模式：将默认的 PowerShell 命令执行链改为 Git Bash（并同步更新模型可见工具与执行细节），并提供配置项与兼容翻译层来保持命令可用性。

summaries.zh: 该插件用于在 DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows 会话中把命令执行切换为 Git for Windows Bash，并支持一键开关与配置管理，以便模型工具面与 Bash 命令语义保持一致。
summaries.en: This plugin switches command execution in DeepSeek Harness on Windows to Git for Windows Bash, with runtime toggle/settings support so model-facing shell usage follows bash semantics.

capabilities: Reroutes Windows command execution from pwsh to Git Bash at runtime
Modifies shell/tool wiring so the model-facing command tool set is switched to bash
Persists and applies an on/off setting for the shell redirection behavior via settings.yaml and plugin API
Provides compatibility translation of command tokens (env vars/drive paths/preamble) before execution
Creates PATH shim scripts for pwsh/powershell command compatibility

reasons.code: The plugin description states it replaces ctx.shell argv usage with ["<git bash>", "-c", command] for foreground/background/sandbox flows.
It removes pwsh tool definitions from the model toolset and registers a bash tool with matching tool behavior.
It exposes GET/POST /api/dsh-all-gitbash and persists enabled/sandboxGate/translation options in settings.yaml.
It documents command translation at execution time: UTF-8 preamble stripping, $env:NAME to ${NAME}, and C:\ path conversion.
Package metadata declares a web client injection plugin bundle (dsh client platform web, immediate), indicating host/runtime integration.
